## Case studies

- [Veilpay](https://coderedxbt.dev/work/veilpay): Multi-chain privacy payments wallet: protocol-specific address isolation, EIP-5564 stealth addresses, ZK circuits; live at veilpayapp.com. Special mention at Stellar Build Station.
- [FreelancePay](https://coderedxbt.dev/work/freelancepay): Trustless milestone escrow as deterministic Soroban contracts on Stellar; zero platform fees. Won $250 USD in Stellar's Journey to Mastery.
- [Avisky (AviQ)](https://coderedxbt.dev/work/avisky): Avisky's AviQ platform: AI-powered aviation training portal with mock test series, predictive analytics, and an AI assistant. Client project, live at avisky.in.
- [VaultPass](https://coderedxbt.dev/work/vaultpass): Privacy-first access control on Midnight: zero-knowledge eligibility proofs with per-gate nullifiers.
